description: 90Prime is a prime-focus wide-field optical CCD mosaic imager on the Steward Observatory 2.3-meter (90-inch) Bok Telescope on Kitt Peak, equipped with UBVRI, SDSS, Washington, and narrow-band filters.
facility_description: The Bart Bok 2.3-meter (90-inch) Telescope is located at Kitt Peak National Observatory in Arizona, owned and operated solely by Steward Observatory at the University of Arizona.
notes: The Steward Observatory MOON wiki documents 90Prime filter tracings and properties under CC BY-SA 4.0. No required observatory-wide publication acknowledgment text is published on the wiki or Bok pages.

licence.scope: Site-wide footer of the Steward Observatory telescope wiki (lavinia.as.arizona.edu/~tscopewiki), shown on every wiki page; it applies to wiki content and is not a data licence written for the filter curves.

R_Bessell.Comments: Renamed from R (2026-10-26) because R and r collided case-insensitively (map: filter_expansion/renamed_filters_20261026_bok.csv). This is SVO's BOK/90prime.R, '90prime R filter' (array identical to SVO's 2025-04-22 capture), the 90Prime broadband R glass filter: the owner's filter page lists 'UBVRI Cousins/Bessel ... R: OG570(2mm) KG3(2mm) Peak-700nm FWHM-220nm' (https://lavinia.as.arizona.edu/~tscopewiki/doku.php?id=public:kitt_peak:bok_90:90prime:filters). The band r is a different curve, the BASS survey r (SVO BOK/BASS.r, full system response).
